notes: The battery's missiles from the rear to the launchers (simcore/campaign/stocks.hpp): the regiment's technical battery at the Horka siding tests what the trains bring and loads the TZMs; the TZMs load the launchers; the battery commander keeps a ledger from what was reported and logged, and asks for missiles by it.
source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 188-189; sam3d estimates and game values where a value says so

launcher_missiles.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p188 (the 9A33BM3 carries six missiles in two containers of three)

tzm_missiles.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p188 (the 9T217BM2 carries up to 12 missiles, six a side), as data/command/battery_tactics.json's tzm_capacity

reload_launcher_s.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p188 (a TZM loads a launcher in 5-8 min): the middle

tests_per_h.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 188-189 (the technical battery's 9V242-1 test station checks 6-7 missiles an hour)

load_tzm_s_per_missile.source: sam3d estimate (G0: a TZM loaded at the technical battery by its crane, 12 missiles in half an hour)

request_when_short.source: game value: the NPC battery commander asks for missiles once his ledger says the battery is short of its full load by a launcher's load or more

request_answer_s.source: sam3d estimate: the regiment's deputy for armament answers a request with a run's time

train_kmh.source: sam3d estimate: a military train's average on the country's lines, stops included

train_missiles.source: game value: what one train brings the technical battery
